_doc: Phase 018: the chatter and weather phrases that bigville/runtime.py realises as speech. The phrases are the village's own words, not a source of fact: a resident says them to others.

SPEECH_CHATTER._doc: Small talk about a trade, keyed by trade name. A trade not listed gets work_template; no trade gets empty.

phrases.smith: The forge has been busy this week.
phrases.baker: The ovens have been going since dawn.
phrases.farmer: The fields need rain, if you ask me.
phrases.fisher: The catch has been thin off the point.
phrases.carpenter: There is always more wood to plane.

SPEECH_CHATTER.work_template: There is always more work in {trade}.

SPEECH_WEATHER._doc: Small talk about the weather, keyed by calendar weather. A weather not listed uses template.

phrases.frost: There is a frost this morning.
